summary.plain: The engineering paper describing MiniBooNE's 12-metre sphere of mineral oil and its 1,520 light sensors.
summary.technical: Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 599 (2009) 28 (arXiv:0806.4201): design and construction of the MiniBooNE spherical mineral-oil Cherenkov/scintillation detector, 818 t target mass, 1520 8-inch PMTs, 541 m from the BNB target.
